#FMSays In response to a question regarding the Philippine foreign ministry's "strong protest" against China's plan, Chinese FM spokesperson Lin Jian said on Thursday that #HuangyanDao is China's inherent territory. The establishment of the Huangyan Dao national nature reserve falls entirely within China's sovereignty and is aimed at protecting the diversity, stability and sustainability of the ecological environment of Huangyan Dao.

This move is in line with China's domestic law and international law, and it fully demonstrates China's sense of responsibility as a major country in actively protecting the ecological environment and promoting sustainable development, Lin added.

The scope of the Philippines' territory has long been defined by a series of international treaties, and Huangyan Dao has never been part of it. China does not accept the Philippines' unreasonable accusations or so-called protests, and urges the Philippines to stop its infringement activities, provocations and attempts to hype up the issue, and avoid adding complexity to the maritime situation, Lin said.

Alinsunod sa adbokasiya ng Hakbang ng Maisug na nananawagan ng 𝐓𝐑𝐀𝐍𝐒𝐏𝐀𝐑𝐄𝐍𝐂𝐘, 𝐀𝐂𝐂𝐎𝐔𝐍𝐓𝐀𝐁𝐈𝐋𝐈𝐓𝐘, 𝐏𝐄𝐀𝐂𝐄 at 𝐒𝐄𝐂𝐔𝐑𝐈𝐓𝐘, malinaw ang aming kapasiyahan at pahayag na kaisa kami ng lahat ng Pilipino, anumang grupo o samahan na nananawagan ng payapang pagkilos upang tahasang kondenahin, maisug na labanan at buong pagsusumikap na matuldukan ang 𝐓𝐀𝐋𝐀𝐌𝐀𝐊, 𝐋𝐀𝐍𝐓𝐀𝐑𝐀𝐍 at 𝐆𝐀𝐑𝐀𝐏𝐀𝐋𝐀𝐍𝐆 𝐊𝐎𝐑𝐀𝐏𝐒𝐘𝐎𝐍 at 𝐊𝐔𝐑𝐀𝐊𝐎𝐓 na nagaganap sa ilalim ng mapagsamantala at organisadong pagnanakaw ng buwis at yaman ng mga Pilipino sa ilalim ng mapagsamantalang  alyansa ni Bongbong Marcos, Martin Romualdez, Zaldy Co at mga galamay na kapwa gahaman sa panggagahasa sa kaban ng bayan. 

Kami ay nakikiisa rin sa payapang pagkilos na tinaguriang 𝐁𝐋𝐀𝐂𝐊 𝐅𝐑𝐈𝐃𝐀𝐘 𝐏𝐄𝐎𝐏𝐋𝐄’𝐒 𝐏𝐑𝐎𝐓𝐄𝐒𝐓 𝐛𝐮𝐤𝐚𝐬, 𝐢𝐤𝐚-𝟏𝟐 𝐧𝐠 𝐒𝐄𝐓𝐘𝐄𝐌𝐁𝐑𝐄, 𝐄𝐃𝐒𝐀-𝐎𝐑𝐓𝐈𝐆𝐀𝐒 𝐬𝐚 𝐠𝐚𝐧𝐚𝐩 𝐧𝐚 𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐬 𝟏𝟏 𝐧𝐠 𝐮𝐦𝐚𝐠𝐚 𝐚𝐭 𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐬 𝟓 𝐧𝐠 𝐡𝐚𝐩𝐨𝐧.

Panahon na ng pagkakaisa, isantabi ang politika at itigil na ang personal na pamumulitika. 

Maisug na manindigan at iparinig ang inyong tinig, sumama sa mga pagkilos laban sa 𝐊𝐎𝐑𝐀𝐏𝐒𝐘𝐎𝐍 at 𝐊𝐔𝐑𝐀𝐊𝐎𝐓 ng Marcos administration. Iligtas ang Pilipinas, ipagtanggol ang Pilipino.
